sentences.en: Emergency services are still looking through the rubble for survivors.
sentences.zh: 救援人员仍在废墟中搜寻幸存者。

sentences.en: The survivors were found on an island, dying of starvation.
sentences.zh: 幸存者们被发现在一个岛上，濒临饿死。

sentences.en: According to the chief of police, there were no survivors.
sentences.zh: 据警察局长说，没有幸存者。

senses.zh: 幸存者，残存者,生还者,遗物，残存物,重新正常生活的人
